recipes.name: Simply Lasagna
ingredients_raw: 1 (15 ounce) container POLLY-O Natural Part Skim Ricotta Cheese
2.5 cups KRAFT Shredded Low-Moisture Part-Skim Mozzarella Cheese, divided
0.5 cup KRAFT Grated Parmesan Cheese, divided

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cook and stir ground beef in a large skillet over medium-high heat until browned and crumbly, 5 to 7 minutes. Turn off the heat; drain and discard grease.
Stir spaghetti sauce into the skillet. Pour water into the empty sauce jar; cover, shake well, then pour liquid into the skillet. Stir until beef and sauce are well combined.
Mix ricotta cheese, 1 1/4 cups mozzarella, 1/4 cup Parmesan, parsley, and egg together in a bowl until well blended.

Spread 1 cup meat sauce over the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish. Top with 3 lasagna noodles, 1/3 of the ricotta mixture, and 1 cup meat sauce. Repeat layers twice more with noodles, ricotta mixture, and meat sauce. Top with remaining noodles and meat sauce, then sprinkle remaining mozzarella and Parmesan over top.
Spray a sheet of aluminum foil with cooking spray. Place the sheet, sprayed-side down, over the baking dish and seal tightly.
Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes. Remove the foil and continue to bake until heated through, about 15 more minutes. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Simply Lasagna
raw_recipe.description: This simple lasagna recipe is flavorful enough for a special dinner but easy enough to make and serve any night of the week.

review.reviewBody: The lasagna was very tasty. I would have given 5 stars but the pasta was too hard when I baked it for 1 hour. I would recommend you cook the pasta halfway through in a pot and then bake the lasagna for 35 mins. Worked wonderfully when I did that.

Added another jar of sauce and subtracted the water. It was the perfect texture with crispy edges. Used ground Italian sausage instead of ground beef for flavor. Also grated fresh Parmesan and mozzarella and topped with chopped basil. Simple and delicious!

This lasagna was amazing! I love it! I did listen to the advice of the other reviewers and used extra sauce. I used a 45 oz jar of Traditional Prego and didn't add any water. Other than that, I just made sure to season every layer well (including onions in the ground beef, and 2 garlic cloves in the sauce), and I also used oven ready noodles. It came out slightly sweet with lots of deep rich flavor and delicate layers. Yum!
Came out great, everyone loved it! I did cook the noodles for a bit before putting in the oven and I used 1 pound of ground beef and one pound of mild Italian sausage and doubled the sauce.

Delicious!! I did do a couple things different with it. I cooked the noodles a bit before assembling it. I used 2lbs of mild Italian sausage, one jar barilla pasta sauce and a can of Italian stewed chopped tomatoes. And I also used a little more mozzarella cheese and a whole 16oz run of whole milk ricotta cheese. Baked it as the recipe said to. The family devoured it!! I will be making this again!!

I made this last night But added 2 extra cheeses It was Amazing there is no more left family and friends enjoyed it and loved it I also Cooked My Noodles Al Dente so It wouldnt have to cook that long and I put 2 tablespoons of Basil Pesto in the Ricotta Cheese and I used preggo Sauce n added 2 tablespoons of brown sugar to it. And I didn't reheat the meat sauce when i added the spagetti sauce because it cooks again while in the oven and i put a long alumium pan of water in the oven while the lasagna cooked at the top so it wouldnt be a mess and it was so moist meaty and chessy we Loved it will be making this dish again
Came out great, everyone loved it! I did cook the noodles for a bit before putting in the oven and I used 1 pound of ground beef and one pound of mild Italian sausage and doubled the sauce.

I've made this recipe twice now. The first time I followed the recipe exactly, and as many people have commented, the result was dry. The second time I made the following changes and it came out perfect:
-- Partially Pre-cook the lasagna noodles. (dip in boiling water for 1 minute)
-- Double the sauce, and only add a half of a jar of water.
-- Have some extra cheese for topping the lasagna before putting it in the oven. Make sure the entire top is covered with cheese or else the noodles will be very dry.
-- Add dried oregano to the Ricotta cheese mixture.

I would eyeball the 1 cup of water, you may not even need it. I added onion and garlic to the beef as well as the 1 cup of water this recipe calls for at the end. This recipe is easy and quick but the water masked all the flavors I had going on. I couldn't taste the onion, garlic, parsley, or the seasonings I added to the beef. Good recipe just watch it with the water.
Delicious!!! I used express noodles that did not need to be cooked ahead of time and it was perfect within the hour! :)

This is a great base recipe, however, I always tend to make some minor changes to most recipes. Hold the water until right before baking and only use 1/2 cup around the edges of the lasagna in the pan. Add a small can of tomato sauce to the sauce mix, season with dried oregano, garlic salt, pepper, and minced onion. Spray foil with cooking spray before baking to prevent sticking. Yum!
I added 2 jars sauce. No just enough water to rinse out the jars. Maybe 1/4 cup. Otherwise made as directed. I’ve been using this recipe for years everyone loves it
Added a lb. of mild Italian sausage, Italian seasoning and garlic salt, another can of tomato sauce and a little more mozarella. Great!

Love this recipe ! Have made it for years and my kiddos are very picky . Only thing I do different is add a small can of tomato sauce along with the jar of spaghetti sauce and about half jar of water to get all the sauce out . I blend it all with Italian seasonings, garlic powder , onion powder and salt and pepper and pour over meat . I also add more of the cheeses! Everyone loves it !
Kids made it, and loved it!
This lasagna is great! The only complaint I would have was it’s a little dry but I’m used to my mother’s juicy lasagna.

Only used 9 lasagna noodles.
Added mushroom, onion and garlic to ground beef mixture.
I add garlic and onion to the hamburger meat, and some bay leaves to the sauce before building the lasagna. A household favorite though!
